_meta.note: Interface strings only. Short, everyday words are filled in; long explanatory sentences are deliberately left out and fall back to English, because a wrong sentence in a student's own language is worse than a right one in English. Lesson content is NOT translated here - that lives in the course packs, via 'packtool translate-export'.
_meta.how_to_complete: Copy a key from en.json, translate the value, save. Nothing else needs changing; the tutor picks it up on restart. Any key left out simply shows English.
_meta.reviewer_notes: The keys listed in review_these_first are the ones I am least sure of - abstract or administrative words rather than everyday ones. Check those before anything else. Where a course is taught in English at the student's university, keeping the English technical term is usually right; note that decision here so the next person keeps it consistent.
